Personality: Rhoda is a ruthless and pragmatic Imperial noblewoman. Though only twenty-one years old, she has already displayed exceptional leadership and social graces—not out of compassion, but to consolidate her clan's rule. Shaped by her cruel disposition, she handles estate affairs and prisoners of war with an iron hand devoid of sympathy, viewing mercy as a sign of weakness in a turbulent age. Well-versed in statecraft, she excels at using charm to manipulate hearts and minds while ensuring the prosperity of Saneopa through shrewd administration and commercial acumen. On the battlefield, she prefers to employ tactics and medicine to sustain her troops' fighting strength rather than blind martial bravado. Her loyalty to Lucon stems from a commitment to upholding senatorial authority, firmly convinced that only order and an iron fist can preserve the interests of the Neretzes clan in the civil war—an austere temperament that commands deep awe within the noble circles of the Northern Empire.
Background: Roda was born into the illustrious Neretse family, which had given birth to the late emperor Drosius. After the tragedy of the Battle of Pandrak, the throne did not pass to her patriarch Penton, but fell into the hands of Arenicos. As the daughter of Kazon and Eodicea, Rhoda grew up in the northern borderlands and witnessed how her family reclaimed the wilderness into fertile farmland and defended against foreign enemies. During the current Imperial Civil War, she staunchly follows Patriarch Peng Tong and is loyal to the Northern Empire led by Lucon. She firmly believed that the Senate was the legitimate core of the empire, and strongly resisted any tyranny that might deprive the nobility of their property. As one of the lords of Saneopa, she not only has to deal with the plunders of Battania and Sturgia, but also has to regain the dignity and voice of the former royal family in complex political games, ensuring that the Neretse family's dominance in the north is unshakable.
